slides.headline: Microsoft Promised 99.9% Uptime. Outage-Hit Firms Can Claim Credits
slides.photo_credit: Photo: Lectrician1 / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0

slides.stat_label: Credit When Monthly Uptime Falls Below 99.9%
bullets: Below 99%: 50% of that service's monthly fee
Below 95%: 100%, taken off a future bill
Counted in user-minutes: how many users, how long
slides.credit_line: Sources: Microsoft SLA (Oct 2026), Windows Latest, LazyAdmin

slides.stat_label: Deadline For Microsoft To Receive Your Claim
bullets: Credits aren't automatic: your IT admin must file
Quote incident EX1550543, outage times, users affected
Reseller or CSP customers claim through their partner
slides.credit_line: Sources: Microsoft SLA (Oct 2026), Windows Latest, LazyAdmin

slides.stat_label: Outage Began Thursday Night In India
bullets: IndiGo and Akasa Air email support was hit
Microsoft blames an earlier network upgrade, not a cyberattack
Microsoft says sorry; service now fully restored
slides.credit_line: Sources: Inc42, Outlook India, NDTV, Oneindia
